alt: Two opposite demo-day scenes, a haunted production hallway and a quiet exhibition with a working app. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: The demo is perfect and prod is haunted. Or prod is perfect and nobody knows it exists. Pick your curse and show your work.

alt: A long receipt scroll and a tiny brass tape stand for two unappealing ways an agent can remember. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: Infinite context that forgets tomorrow, or tiny context that remembers forever? Which agent are you bringing back for the second edit?

alt: A vinyl station and a modem room show two ways to lose a favourite thing. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: Perfect music with no internet or perfect internet with no music. I want to hear from the people picking silence.

alt: Two relief prints, one of a trapped key and the other of a heavy pager, illustrate a choice about ownership. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: One click and you lose the keys, or own it and carry the pager. Which would you choose for something you plan to keep running?

alt: A dark terminal and an archive cabinet frame a choice between missing logs and an old restore. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: Fix prod without logs or restore from a year ago. One move. What’s the first thing you do?

alt: A computer trivia card presents four options for HTTP 418. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: What is HTTP 418 famously called? Drop your answer, then take the whole App Composer quiz.

alt: A Git quiz card asks what points to the current branch, with four possible references. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: Which reference names the current branch in an attached Git checkout? Reply A, B, C or D, then try the rest of the round.

alt: A red and cream quiz card asks which permission class can write in Unix mode 0755. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: In Unix mode 0755, which permission class has the write bit? Pick an answer before you try the whole round.

alt: A microcomputer and a tiny mouse appear on a newspaper crossword cover. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: One across, three down. The big clue is “command interpreter”. Solve the grid, then send it to someone who still reads man pages.

alt: A green terminal and six fuses advertise a guess-the-word game. App Composer Computer Club.
caption: Six misses, one word. The first clue is “time travel for a release, minus the paradox.” See how many fuses you have left.
